title: Data and AI Knowledge Engineer - Associate
description:
**Position Summary**
The Data and AI Knowledge Engineer will prepare, organize, govern, and operate the structured and unstructured information required by the firm’s AI applications. The role is accountable for creating reliable pipelines, retrieval structures, metadata, quality controls, and lineage so AI solutions operate from current, permission-aware, and authoritative information.
  
  
This is not primarily a reporting or data-analyst role. The successful candidate must be capable of engineering data and knowledge systems that support enterprise AI, automation, analytics, and traceable decision support.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Data and knowledge architecture**

* Inventory and profile structured databases, SharePoint repositories, document libraries, APIs, Dataverse tables, and other approved data sources.
* Establish authoritative-source hierarchies and identify duplicate, conflicting, outdated, or incomplete content.
* Design data models, taxonomies, metadata, indexes, and knowledge structures.
* Work with practice SMEs to define content labels, business terminology, document types, effective dates, service categories, industries, and other contextual metadata.

**Data pipelines and integration**

* Develop ingestion, transformation, enrichment, synchronization, and archival pipelines.
* Build data-quality checks, reconciliation routines, and exception monitoring.
* Integrate data across Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Dataverse, SQL, SharePoint, and external APIs.
* Maintain lineage between source information, transformed content, retrieval indexes, and downstream AI responses.
* Establish refresh schedules and stale-content detection.

**Retrieval engineering**

* Configure Azure AI Search and other approved knowledge-retrieval services.
* Develop chunking, segmentation, embedding, metadata-filtering, hybrid-search, and reranking approaches.
* Test retrieval precision, completeness, ranking, citation traceability, and permission behavior.
* Optimize indexes for quality, speed, cost, and maintainability.
* Support AI engineers with representative evaluation and regression datasets.

**Data governance and operations**

* Implement technical controls for data classification, sensitivity, permission trimming, retention, deletion, and access.
* Support source-owner approvals and periodic content revalidation.
* Monitor data-pipeline health, index freshness, source availability, and quality exceptions.
* Develop Power BI reporting for data quality, solution usage, value, cost, and operational performance.
* Document schemas, metadata, lineage, data ownership, business rules, and known quality limitations.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Advanced SQL and relational data modeling.
* Python for data processing, automation, and quality validation.
* Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or comparable pipeline technologies.
* Azure AI Search, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, embeddings, metadata filtering, and reranking.
* Dataverse, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure Data Lake, and SQL platforms.
* APIs, file ingestion, ETL and ELT patterns, and event-based synchronization.
* Power BI semantic modeling and operational reporting.
* Data lineage, data quality, master data, taxonomy, metadata, retention, and security concepts.
* Row-level and object-level security, sensitivity handling, and access-control testing.

**Preferred Experience**

* 1-2 or more years in data engineering, information architecture, search engineering, analytics engineering, or related disciplines.
* Experience preparing unstructured content for AI or enterprise search.
* Experience supporting retrieval-augmented generation applications.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, SharePoint, Dataverse, and Power BI.
* Experience in regulated, confidential, or professional-services environments.
* Familiarity with document-management, records-management, and knowledge-management practices.

**Success Measures**

* Data-source availability and pipeline reliability.
* Retrieval precision and completeness.
* Index freshness and stale-content rate.
* Data-quality exception volume and resolution.
* Source-to-response traceability.
* Permission and access-control test performance.
* Reuse of common data models, taxonomies, and ingestion patterns.
* Reduction in duplicate or conflicting knowledge.
* Completeness of lineage, metadata, and ownership documentation.

**Role Boundaries**
This role ensures information is technically ready for AI use. Business and practice data owners remain accountable for determining authoritative content, approving permitted uses, resolving substantive conflicts, and maintaining the source information.

The IAM Security Assurance Architect is responsible for reviewing all new applications, platforms, cloud services, and technology changes to ensure they meet the organisation's baseline IAM security requirements before they go live.
  
  
The role acts as the IAM security review authority within technology delivery and change processes, and builds the automation needed to provide continuous assurance that identity and access controls remain effective throughout the application lifecycle. The focus is on two outcomes: rigorous security reviews and automated, always-on assurance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
one. IAM Security Reviews
  
  

* Serve as the IAM security review authority for new applications, technology platforms, cloud workloads, and infrastructure changes.
* Review designs and change requests through project lifecycle and design checkpoint governance processes.
* Assess and approve applications against baseline IAM security requirements, including:

+ Authentication standards
+ MFA requirements
+ Privileged access controls
+ Role-based access models
+ Segregation of Duties requirements
+ Identity lifecycle (joiner / mover / leaver) requirements
+ Account provisioning and deprovisioning controls
+ Service account and non-human identity management standards
+ Federation and Single Sign-On requirements

* Review application access models, role structures, entitlement designs, and access matrices.
* Classify application criticality and confirm IAM onboarding requirements are met.
* Identify security risks, control gaps, and remediation actions, and confirm closure before deployment.
* Provide clear, documented review decisions and risk-based approvals to delivery teams.

two. Assurance Automation & Continuous Compliance
  
  

* Design and build automation that continuously validates whether applications and platforms meet baseline IAM security requirements.
* Automate evidence collection and control checks to reduce manual review effort and provide always-on assurance.
* Establish automated, continuous monitoring for:

+ Orphaned accounts
+ Stale and dormant identities
+ Excessive or unused privileges
+ Toxic access combinations
+ Service account and non-human identity risks
+ Privileged account misuse
+ Deviations from approved access baselines

* Integrate assurance checks with IAM platforms and security tooling (e.g., SailPoint, Entra ID, Active Directory, CyberArk, cloud CIEM).
* Define Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and IAM assurance health metrics.
* Build and maintain dashboards that surface control effectiveness and non-compliance for remediation.
* Drive an automate-first approach to control validation, minimising point-in-time manual checks.

3. Remediation, Risk & Reporting
  
  

* Track and drive closure of IAM security review findings and assurance exceptions.
* Review IAM-related risk assessments, exceptions, and remediation plans.
* Support internal and external audits with review evidence and assurance data.
* Report on review throughput, control coverage, and residual risk to IAM leadership.

4. Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Partner with application, engineering, cloud, and change teams to embed security-by-design in delivery.
* Advise project teams on how to meet baseline IAM requirements early in the lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Security, Risk, and Audit functions on assurance outcomes and control gaps.

Key Deliverables
  
  

* IAM Security Review Decisions & Risk-Based Approvals
* Baseline IAM Requirement Assessments for New Applications
* Continuous Assurance Automation & Control Validation Framework
* Automated Evidence Collection & Compliance Checks
* IAM Assurance Dashboards & Metrics (KRIs / KPIs)

description:
**Your Job**
As an IT Infrastructure Delivery Engineer at Koch, your primary goal is to move the organization away from rigid, legacy hardware and toward a fluid, software-defined ecosystem. You aren't just "fixing routers" you are the architect of a global fabric that connects branches, data centers, and multi-cloud environments (AWS/Azure/Alkira) into one seamless, secure entity.
  
  
This role will be instrumental in designing, implementing, and managing solutions that protect enterprise users, applications, and data in a modern, cloud & on-prem environment. The engineer will work closely with architecture, security, operations, and vendors to ensure high-quality, scalable, and secure access.
  
  
**Our Team**
The KOCH Infrastructure team provides reliable, flexible, and secure connectivity solutions that enable business solutions and perpetual transformation. We manage network and network security infrastructure, including wide area networking, local area networking, wireless, firewalls, datacentre networking, load balancing, endpoint security, and proxies. We provide enterprise infrastructure monitoring for IT components across the enterprise. We are currently focused on the following transformation strategies: talent, proactive management, process optimization and automation, security by design, and adopting a service focused organization.
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Design & Standards Leadership: You don’t just follow templates; you build them. You’ll be responsible for developing new global standards for the network, creating high-level designs (HLD), and ensuring every site rollout follows a clean, documented blueprint (LLD).
* Cisco & Meraki Mastery: You’ll live in the "Command Centers"—Cisco vManage for the complex Viptela enterprise sites and the Meraki Dashboard for lean branch deployments. You’ll be the go-to expert for configuring global control policies, managing the vSmart controllers, and ensuring the fabric stays healthy.
* The Wireless Experience: Beyond the WAN, you’ll own the Meraki Wireless environment. This means designing high-density Wi-Fi layouts, managing SSID policies, and ensuring seamless roaming and connectivity for users across the office.

title: Consultant- Performance QA
description:
**Summary**
Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to design, implement, and optimize mission-critical solutions on the Guidewire platform, with a strong focus on cloud and AI-enabled delivery. You’ll join a collaborative, global team that values curiosity, transparency, and continuous improvement, working closely with customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
As a Performance Test Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring that Guidewire-based projects/ solutions meet defined performance, scalability, and stability goals. You will design and execute performance tests, analyze results to identify bottlenecks and areas for optimization, and collaborate closely with functional QA, developers, and architects to help deliver high-quality, reliable solutions for our P&C insurance customers.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**

* Take end-to-end ownership of performance testing for assigned projects, from requirement analysis through sign-off.
* Work with architects, functional QA, business analysts, and developers to understand business flows, volumes, SLAs, and peak load expectations.
* Design performance test approach and scenarios, including workload models, test data strategy, and environment pre-requisites.
* Develop, maintain, and execute performance test scripts using tools such as JMeter (or equivalent).
* Execute different types of performance tests (load, stress, endurance/soak, spike, scalability) and capture key metrics.
* Monitor application, database, and infrastructure during test runs, and consolidate findings into clear, actionable reports.
* Analyze test results to identify hotspots and potential risks; provide recommendations for tuning and retest as needed.
* Collaborate with development and DevOps/cloud teams to validate fixes and configuration changes.
* Maintain all performance test artefacts: test plans, scripts, datasets, execution logs, and result summaries.
* Share performance testing best practices with functional QA and junior team members; support knowledge sharing within the QA practice.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 4-6 years of overall software QA experience, with at least 3 years focused on performance testing of web or enterprise applications.
* Hands-on experience with at least one performance testing tool (e.g., JMeter, Gatling; LoadRunner or similar is a plus).
* Good understanding of performance test types and key concepts: response time, throughput, concurrency, error rates, capacity, and SLAs.
* Ability to interpret and correlate performance metrics across:

+ Application / JVM (threads, heap, GC, response times, throughput)
+ Database (slow queries, indexing, connection pooling)
+ Infrastructure (CPU, memory, network, disk I/O)

* Experience using monitoring / APM tools (e.g., Datadog, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar) to support analysis.
* Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex performance issues under time pressure.
* Good communication skills and stakeholder management; comfortable working with distributed, cross-functional teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Guidewire applications (PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter) or other large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms.
* Exposure to testing in cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP) and distributed architectures.
* Prior experience in a Professional Services / implementation or customer-facing delivery environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
